recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not remove or rewrite specimen-in-process under FHIR-33041; any future removal should wait for a final successor decision such as a resolved FHIR-54892.
issue_request: FHIR-33041 asked whether the HL7 v2 OBX-11 state "Specimen in Lab; results are pending" / in-process should map to Observation.status=registered or need a separate status. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution added a level-1 Specimen-in-Process status code after Registered for a specimen being processed in the laboratory when no results are available yet.
initial_application: Commit cf4d553a6a5a6d56da1af43dbbdb3b987bdb0d0c added specimen-in-process to source/observation/codesystem-observation-status.xml. Follow-up commits 801bfdfc63685f9de0eca1ee09b0aafdd3b51b79 and 9116279038b62c39a08fdd12fdebc6b6a02f96bb updated status-codes.xml and the Observation/RiskAssessment status short text. PR #3154 was merged as d22fa851724ea7e6bb70d4942749754660b79b80, matching the Jira application comment.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has specimen-in-process as a top-level CodeSystem concept immediately after registered, and the parallel Observation.status, event mapping exception, status-codes.xml, and RiskAssessment.status listings include the code. Companion OBX-11 status issues FHIR-33042 and FHIR-33043 are already represented on the combined branch. Later mentions FHIR-54892 and FHIR-54153 are Triaged/Unresolved and do not override the Applied seed decision.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The active current source already implements the Applied resolution; the minor grammatical difference in the concept definition does not alter implementer understanding.
